investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pixstack Shop (online retail); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west1 (zones europe-west1-b/europe-west1-c/europe-west1-d); network range 10.131.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster pixsta-prod-europe (GKE); Edge: provider-managed load balancer (edge-lb) in front of web-bff backends; a standby load balancer exists in a secondary region; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
